title: Paneer Bhurji
subtitle: Creamy scrambled paneer with tomato and capsicum — a fast, high-protein weekday breakfast.

nightPrep.label: Night Before (optional)
items: Chop capsicum, tomato, coriander; refrigerate in a small container

method.title: Toddler portion first
items: Set aside crumbled paneer {100g}, capsicum {2 tbsp}, tomato {2 tbsp}

method.label: Toddler cooking (~5 min, do first)
items: Heat small pan on low; add butter {½ tsp}
Add tomato and capsicum {2 tbsp each}; cook 2 min until soft
Add paneer {100g}, pinch turmeric, pinch salt; stir 1–2 min — keep moist
Optional: mash in ½ boiled potato for extra calories
Serve with soft roti or toast soldiers

method.title: Build the base
items: Heat ghee {2 tbsp} in a wide pan on medium-high
Add cumin seeds {1 tsp}; splutter 20 sec
Add hing {¼ tsp} and ginger {1½ tsp}; stir 30 sec
Add remaining tomatoes; cook 4–5 min until oil separates
Add remaining capsicum; stir-fry 2 min, keep slight crunch

method.title: Spice and finish
items: Add turmeric {¼ tsp}, red chili powder {½ tsp}, coriander powder {1 tsp}, cumin powder {½ tsp}, salt to taste; stir 30 sec
Add remaining paneer {~300g}; fold gently — don't mash
Cook 2–3 min; add garam masala {¼ tsp} and kasuri methi {1 tsp}
Finish with lemon juice {½ tsp}; garnish with coriander {2 tbsp}

method.label: Tip
method.text: High heat when cooking tomatoes is key — it develops flavor fast. Don't overcook after adding paneer; it should stay soft and moist.
